business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a three-person electrical contractor', 'a painting and drywall crew'.

toolsets.reason: Turns a finished quote into a PDF or Word document to send.

tools.name: quotes_status
tools.description: Every quote with its id and exact total: the follow-ups due (overdue first), the drafts being priced, the quotes sent and waiting, the win/loss record, and the saved rates, tax and terms. Call it first when asked about quotes, follow-ups or totals.

tools.name: start_quote
tools.description: Start a quote the moment a job is mentioned, before you describe it: a short title for the job, the client, contact and site. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Then price it with add_quote_line.

id.description: Pass it to change an existing quote.

title.description: The job, e.g. "Maple Row panel upgrade".

tools.name: add_quote_line
tools.description: Add one line to a quote: labor, materials or other, with a description, quantity, unit and rate in dollars (or rateName for a saved rate). The tool works out the amount, the tax and the total exactly; never add them up yourself. The same description updates that line, and addQty adds to its quantity (e.g. 6 more hours).

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

description.description: What the line is, e.g. "Electrician labor" or "200A panel".

addQty.description: Instead of qty: how much to add to that line’s quantity, e.g. 6 more hours.

rateName.description: Or: a saved rate by name, e.g. "Electrician".

tools.name: remove_quote_line
tools.description: Take a line off a quote, by its number or description.

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

tools.name: send_quote
tools.description: Mark a quote sent the moment the person says it went out. It sets the valid-until date and the first follow-up from the business’s terms.

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

followUpAt.description: First follow-up date, YYYY-MM-DD, when not the usual.

tools.name: log_quote_follow_up
tools.description: Record a follow-up on a sent quote (a call, an email, what the client said) and when to chase next: followUpAt or inDays, or the usual gap when not given.

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

note.description: What happened, in the person’s words.

inDays.description: Or: the next follow-up this many days from today.

tools.name: record_quote_outcome
tools.description: Record that a quote was won or lost the moment the person says so, with the reason in note. Won and lost quotes are closed and their price is settled.

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

tools.name: save_rate
tools.description: Save one of the business’s rates: a name (e.g. "Electrician"), labor, materials or other, the unit (hour, each, foot) and the price in dollars. The same name updates the rate.

tools.name: set_quote_terms
tools.description: Set the sales tax the business charges (a percent, 0 for none) and whether it applies to materials only or the whole quote, and how many days quotes stay valid and wait before a follow-up. Draft quotes are re-totaled; sent quotes keep their tax.

taxRate.description: The sales tax percent the business charges, e.g. 8.25 (0 for none).

tools.name: show_quote
tools.description: One quote line by line: each line’s quantity, rate and amount, then the subtotal, tax and total.

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

id.description: Pass it to change an existing quote.

title.description: The job, e.g. "Maple Row panel upgrade".

tools.name: page_add_quote_line
tools.description: Add or change a line on a quote.

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

description.description: What the line is, e.g. "Electrician labor" or "200A panel".

addQty.description: Instead of qty: how much to add to that line’s quantity, e.g. 6 more hours.

rateName.description: Or: a saved rate by name, e.g. "Electrician".

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

followUpAt.description: First follow-up date, YYYY-MM-DD, when not the usual.

tools.description: Record a follow-up on a sent quote.

title.description: The quote’s title or client, when no id.

note.description: What happened, in the person’s words.

inDays.description: Or: the next follow-up this many days from today.
